title: Automate trade-document generation and export
description: Close the audited Trade Document Center usability gap using existing persisted fields: add generation/prefill actions from Sales Orders and Container Loading Lists, prevent duplicate generated document sets, and provide practical Excel export for document-center records. Do not introduce a new production schema in this task.
acceptance_criteria: Users can generate/prefill Trade Document Center records from a Sales Order and from a Container Loading List using existing document fields.
Generated records carry source order/container references, customer/port/amount data where available, and preserve manual editability before approval.
Duplicate generation from the same source and document type is guarded or made idempotent.
Document-center list/detail supports Excel export using the existing export conventions.
Unit/integration tests cover both source paths, mapping, duplicate protection and export; existing safe validation remains green.
Real Edge acceptance covers one Sales Order source and one Container Loading source with generated records visible in Document Center.

scenarios: Generate a trade-document record from a Sales Order and verify mapped source/order/customer data.
Generate a trade-document record from a Container Loading List and verify container/port/source data.
Repeat one generation action and verify no unintended duplicate record set is created.

human_gate.reason: Uses existing document-center schema and application paths only.
